description: Returns the recent changes in the library, optionally since a date, within a folder or for one page. Read-only.

prefix.description: Folder path to scope the results to (e.g. 'clients/acme')

since.description: Lower time bound: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), ISO-8601 with Z or offset, or epoch ms/s. Only later changes are returned

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_recent
title: Outbox: recent changes
